why: It is a neat trick that a tiny language can be stretched by code rewriting alone.
content: Brainfuck cell widths can be expanded by a conversion that makes a normal 8-bit program run as its 16-bit or 32-bit version.
evidence: This is a set of translations to make normal 8-bit Brainfuck use 2 or 4 cells. Basically, by applying one of these conversions, you can make a normal BF program run as its 16-bit or 32-bit version on an 8-bit BF interpreter.
